adjudication.rationale: Research structure, current product mappings, direct allergen authority, target repair, Ingredient Intelligence timing, focused validation, and idempotency passed the POC terminal gates.

evidence.excerpt: The exact restaurant-linked Toast store confirms 45981 Woodpecker Square and exposes 17 current category/featured surfaces with 127 published rows before featured and cross-category repetitions are collapsed.

The live Wix menu exposes two simultaneously published 11-category collections. They mostly mirror one another but differ at product level, including Chicken Qeema Paratha versus Chicken Qeema Naan and Rabri Falooda appearing only in the primary collection.
The restaurant-linked DoorDash Commerce store confirms 45981 Woodpecker Sq and exposes current Featured, Most Ordered, and 15 food/nonalcoholic category surfaces.
The current catering page offers customizable catering and explicitly lists live stations for Julebi, Pani Puri, Paan, and Chai.

Fresh official-domain, document, linked-vendor, and targeted searches reconfirmed the Woodpecker Square restaurant and current menu pages. No comprehensive restaurant-issued allergen matrix or facility cross-contact statement was found; the searchable Uber Eats result instead showed 45965 Regal Plaza and was excluded.

The restaurant-controlled homepage identifies Clove at 45981 Woodpecker Sq, Sterling, VA 20165, provides the current hours and phone number, and links the official menu, catering page, DoorDash store, and Toast pickup store.
